business.homeApplianceDesc: We supply core control boards for household appliances including refrigerators, water purifiers, range hoods, and air purifiers.
business.industrialTitle1: Engineered for the heart of industry.
business.industrialDesc: We provide core control technology for industrial equipment including dishwashers, pumps, meeting pods, and temperature controllers.
business.medicalDesc: We design and supply control boards for medical equipment including centrifuges, dental scalers, and diagnostic devices.
business.renewableDesc: We provide control technology for eco-friendly energy systems including solar, hydrogen, and lithium-ion charging applications.
